title: pkg/machine: apply ro mount option to virtiofs shares
body:
When mounting virtiofs volumes in virtual machines (such as libkrun or AppleHV providers on macOS), volume configurations containing the `:ro` flag are correctly parsed into `vmconfigs.Mount` with `ReadOnly: true`. However, `GenerateSystemDFilesForVirtiofsMounts` omitted this flag when constructing systemd mount units, causing the guest VM to mount the shares read-write.

This change:
1. Adds `ro` to the virtiofs systemd mount options in `GenerateSystemDFilesForVirtiofsMounts` when `mnt.ReadOnly` is true.
2. Preserves `OriginalInput` when translating VirtIOFS volumes in `CmdLineVolumesToMounts`.
3. Adds automated unit test coverage for virtiofs read-only mount unit options, volume option combinations, and VirtIOFS mount conversion helpers.

Fixes #29897
